about: How the game's banks changed since the builds listed (tools/import_bank_history.py), so that a mod made for one of them reads right on the current game (addition.from_patch): per bank file id, 'gone' are object ids those versions had and this one doesn't, 'new' object ids this one has and they didn't, 'changed' the fingerprints (bank.fingerprint) an object had in them where this one has it otherwise.
